Apply to the UT Health Science Center
How to Apply
Submit the Application(s) for Admission
All UT Health Science Center academic programs require the submission of an application
through a central application service (AMCAS, NursingCAS, PharmCAS, etc.).
Use the drop-down menu under "Information by Program" to discover program information,
application links, and contact information.
Submit Transcripts and Supporting Materials
Applications are considered incomplete until all applicable documents, including official
transcripts and test scores, are received through the central application service
in which you applied.
Sending transcripts, test scores, and other documentation directly to UT Health Science
Center may prevent your application from being considered complete.
After you are admitted to the university you may be asked to submit additional final
transcripts.
